page_title: La Casa del Cuore – Welcome to Taranto
welcome_html:
Welcome to La Casa del Cuore! We are Lucia and Marco, your hosts, and we are delighted to have you here. We take care of every little detail to make your stay as pleasant as possible — we hope the apartment exceeds your expectations.

Below you will find everything you need to get into the apartment. You will need a code, which we will send you after receiving the passport photos of all guests.
step1_p1_html: We are at {address} — open in Google Maps.
cap_building: The building seen from the street
alt_building: The building seen from the street
warn_parking_html: The house has no private parking. We recommend parking on the nearby streets, following the road signs.
step2_p1_html: To enter the building you need the main door key. The door is open and watched by the concierge in the morning until 12:30 and in the afternoon from 16:00 to 18:30 (not on Sundays). If you arrive at these times, just walk in and go straight to the next step: you will also find the main door key in the indoor key safe.
step2_note_html: The outdoor key safe is only needed if the door is closed, i.e. outside the concierge's hours and on Sundays. You will find it hooked to the gate. Enter the code we sent you to open it and take the main door key.
cap_locker_out: Outdoor key safe — only outside concierge hours and on Sundays
alt_locker_out: Outdoor key safe hooked to the gate
badge_out: Only if the door is closed
step3_p1_html: Take the lift (or the stairs) to the third floor: our apartment is unit A.
step3_p2_html: Next to the door you will find a key safe fixed to the wall. Enter the code we sent you to open it and take the house keys, together with a main door key. The doorbell is right next to it.
cap_locker_in: Indoor key safe — third floor, unit A
alt_locker_in: Indoor key safe with keypad, next to the doorbell
contact_p_html: We are always available. Feel free to contact us for anything you need.
contact_footer: We wish you a wonderful stay. Thank you for choosing us!
